say: The tall ones! They sang while they built. I remember the songs. Do you want one?
I grew in their city. They watered me with amethyst water. They were kind.
The Precursors built down, %1$s, deep under the slate. They were hiding something. Or from something.
Their cities are your ruins. Their children are your villagers. Diminished. Forgetful.
They built the temples to keep something asleep at the end of time. I know what. I will not say it yet.
I remember every street of every city they had. You walk over them every day.
